## Fixture data and helpers

What screens fill components with (`src/data`): synthetic listings and brokers, AcmeCo's navigation and footer content, formatters. No real listings, people or logos.

### data/breadcrumbs

The breadcrumb trails the screens show (decision 47), in AcmeCo's wording: the space type, the state, the city, then the page. Fixture places only (Denver, Colorado).

- `listingTrail`: `(listing: Listing) => BreadcrumbItem[]`
- `searchTrail`: `(city: string, state: string, search: string) => BreadcrumbItem[]`
- `backTrail`: `(from: { label: string; href: string; }, here: string) => BreadcrumbItem[]`

### data/facts.tsx

Label / value facts for FactList (decision 47), from a listing's fixture data. The labels are AcmeCo's; values come only from fields the fixtures have (no subtype or parking yet). Prices carry spoken units, as PropertyPrice does.

- `propertyFacts`: `(listing: Listing, listedOn: string) => Fact[]`
- `spaceFacts`: `(space: Space) => Fact[]`
- `spaceColumns`: `({ id: string; label: string; isRowHeader: boolean; hideLabel?: undefined; } \| { id: string; label: string; isRowHeader?: undefined; hideLabel?: undefined; } \| { id: string; label: string; hideLabel: boolean; isRowHeader?: undefined; })[]`
- `spaceCells`: `(space: Space) => { space: string; size: ReactNode; rate: ReactNode; use: PropertyType; available: string; }`

### data/fixtures

SYNTHETIC fixtures. Street names, companies and people are invented; no real listings, brokers or photos. Adapted from the audit prototype's fixtures, with AcmeCo's listing tiers (1/2/3) and 1-3 brokers per listing added.

- `brokers`: `Broker[]`
- `listings`: `Listing[]`
- `brokerById`: `(id: string) => Broker`

### data/footer

The footer's content, in AcmeCo's order and words (live site, 2026-10-10), for stories and screens (the Footer takes it as props). Addresses are placeholders. Marketplace sites open in a new tab, as on AcmeCo. Social and app links are neutral placeholders: the providers' marks are licensed artwork (decision 35, E).

- `footerColumns`: `FooterColumn[]`
- `footerSocial`: `FooterSocialLink[]`
- `footerApps`: `{ label: string; href: string; external: boolean; }[]`
- `footerPhoneLinks`: `{ label: string; href: string; external: boolean; }[]`

### data/format

Text formatting shared by the PropertyCard parts, so a price or size reads the same everywhere. AcmeCo's own wording where it was captured ("SF Available", "Price Upon Request", "Built in 1963").

- `priceText`: `(price: Price) => { visible: string; spoken?: string \| undefined; muted?: boolean \| undefined; }`
- `sizeRange`: `(size: { min: number; max: number; }) => string`
- `sizeAvailable`: `(listing: Pick<Listing, "size" \| "listingType" \| "type">) => string`
- `cityLine`: `(l: Pick<Listing, "city" \| "state" \| "zip">) => string`

### data/illustrations

Illustrative placeholder photos: simple drawings of buildings under a sky, generated from a seed, so stories and pages never use real photography. Returned as SVG data URLs, so components receive ordinary image URLs exactly as they would with real photos. Adapted from the audit prototype's PropertyImage. These colours are illustration content, not UI, so they aren't design tokens.

- `buildingIllustration`: `(seed: number) => string`
- `mapIllustration`: `(seed?: number) => string`

### data/locales

AcmeCo's language-and-region and currency choices (the globe's dialog, live site, 2026-10-10), for stories and screens (components take them as props).

- `locales`: `ChoiceCardOption[]`
- `currencies`: `ChoiceCardOption[]`

### data/navigation

Site navigation content for stories and screens (not for components: they take it as props).

- `searchLinks`: `NavigationLink[]`

### data/sign-in

The sign-in dialog's promo slides, for stories and screens (components take them as props).

- `signInSlides`: `SignInSlide[]`

### data/site-menu

The header menu's links, in AcmeCo's order and words (live site, 2026-10-10), for stories and screens. Addresses are placeholders: the prototype has no pages behind them.

- `menuLinksBefore`: `SiteMenuLink[]`
- `menuSearchLinks`: `SiteMenuLink[]`
- `menuLinksAfter`: `SiteMenuLink[]`
